selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-reboot boot identity and supporting health
selected_evidence.summary: Captures boot ID 267e568a-ef2b-4189-9a7f-50a72b044473, active rsyslog, valid sudoers, and installed configuration.
Confirms the native safe reboot was scheduled asynchronously.
The first and later polls all returned connection reset. A changed boot identity and recovered services/data could not be observed, so restart persistence is not claimed.

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 077
printf '%s\n' '# Dedicated sudo command log; keep sudo events out of syslog.' 'Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo-commands.log",log_year,!syslog' > /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging
chown root:root /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging
chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging
install -o root -g root -m 0600 /dev/null /var/log/sudo-commands.log
visudo -cf /etc/sudoers
printf '%s\n' '--- installed config ---'
cat /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging
printf '%s\n' '--- target metadata ---'
stat -c '%n %U:%G %a %s bytes' /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging /var/log/sudo-commands.log
